categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of specialized functional wet electronic chemicals used in printed circuit boards (PCBs), packaging substrates, and advanced semiconductor packaging. Its product portfolio includes chemical copper deposition chemicals, electroplating chemicals, copper surface treatment chemicals, advanced packaging chemicals, and other specialized chemicals for electronic circuits and semiconductor applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary chemical deposition and electrochemical deposition technologies, including horizontal chemical copper deposition, electroplating with insoluble anodes, and surface treatment processes such as roughening and micro-etching. It has developed advanced formulations compatible with high-frequency, high-density interconnect (HDI), soft-hard combination boards, and semiconductor packaging substrates. Production involves precise chemical formulation mixing in liquid form, with strict quality control and ERP-driven order-based manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are manufacturers of high-end printed circuit boards, semiconductor packaging substrates, and display panels, including well-known domestic PCB and semiconductor companies. The company serves industries such as electronics manufacturing, semiconductor advanced packaging, AI computing, 5G communications, automotive electronics, and consumer electronics. Major clients include leading PCB fabricators and semiconductor packaging firms in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Zhuhai and subsidiaries in Shanghai, Suzhou, and Guangdong. It is expanding its overseas presence with plans to build a production facility in Thailand to serve Southeast Asian markets. The company also targets domestic regions including East China, South China, and Central China, with increasing sales in these areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the electronic materials supply chain, specializing in the production of core functional wet electronic chemicals essential for PCB and semiconductor substrate manufacturing. It supplies critical raw materials and chemical additives used in key manufacturing processes such as chemical copper deposition and electroplating.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on technology-driven growth, emphasizing R&D in chemical deposition and electroplating technologies for high-end PCB and semiconductor packaging applications. It invests heavily in innovation to develop products for emerging fields like advanced semiconductor packaging (TSV, RDL, bumping, TGV), 5G materials, and new energy electronics. The company also prioritizes expanding overseas markets and enhancing production capacity to support industry upgrades and domestic substitution of imported materials.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of specialized functional wet electronic chemical products to PCB manufacturers, semiconductor packaging firms, and related downstream customers. The company mainly uses a direct sales model with some distribution, and pricing is based on product volume, contract terms, and customized solutions. It also provides technical support and after-sales services to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes against international giants such as Atotech, DowDuPont, MacDermid, and JCU, which dominate the high-end functional wet electronic chemicals market. However, it holds a leading position domestically as a high-tech enterprise with nearly 30 years of R&D experience, strong product quality, and customer service. It is recognized as a key player in China's import substitution and industry upgrading efforts, gradually breaking foreign monopolies in high-end PCB and semiconductor chemical materials.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 380.67 million, representing a 12.32% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 74.68 million, up 27.5%. The company maintains a solid financial base with total assets exceeding RMB 1.24 billion and net assets over RMB 1.12 billion. R&D investment accounted for 7.35% of revenue, reflecting a growth trajectory supported by continuous innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced proprietary chemical technologies tailored for high-end PCB and semiconductor packaging processes, offering high-quality, stable, and customized chemical solutions that meet stringent industry requirements. Its strong R&D capabilities, rapid technical support, and close customer collaboration enable it to provide reliable, innovative products that enhance electronic device performance and support domestic industry upgrading and import substitution.
